name: io.github.hoornet/agentdocs-mcp
description: MCP server for AgentDocs (agentdocs.eu): read, search, write, comment on & share Markdown docs.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTDOCS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: AgentDocs API token (account or space-scoped). Profile → Regenerate API Token, or Space settings → Tokens.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTDOCS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the AgentDocs API base URL. Advanced — defaults to the hosted service at https://agentdocs.eu; set this only if you have been given a different endpoint.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: AgentDocs API token, as "Token <api_token>" (account or space-scoped). "Bearer <api_token>" is also accepted. Profile → Regenerate API Token, or Space settings → Tokens.
